_comment: Declared pack policy. `chaoslab lint` expands this over candidates.txt and the pack assessment, walks the required-dependency closure, and renders PACK.md and reports/pack_report.md. Edit this file; never edit the derived documents.

decisions.D4: Option B: milestone A is core + seed + support + add-on; outside the promoted sections (Tech, Dimensions / worldgen, Quest systems) adoption, trial and defer wait for milestone B, while a promoted section ships whole; libraries arrive transitively.
decisions.D4_magic: Two magic systems only: Ars Nouveau and Iron's Spells. Primal Magick and Golem Magicka stay resolvable alternatives at milestone B.
decisions.D4_tech: Full tech section ships in milestone A (Create, Mekanism, Oritech, AnvilCraft, Electrodynamics, plus the section's add-ons).
decisions.D4_worldgen: No terrain trimming: every worldgen and structure candidate stays in the manifest at milestone A or milestone B; none is dropped.
decisions.D4_quests: The quest layer ships in milestone A, so the Quest systems section is promoted.
decisions.D5: Replacements for the seven no-build slugs are ratified as recorded; asterism-arcanum and lootr are excluded by policy.
decisions.D6: Delivery option A: `.mrpack` referencing Modrinth CDN URLs, jars are not bundled.

exclusions.lootr: §6.12: chests are shared and one-shot; Lootr makes them per-player instanced
exclusions.asterism-arcanum-addon-for-irons-spells-: 1.21.1 build requires expandability, which is CurseForge-only; Modrinth-only policy (§7 row 27)

overrides.reason: D4 magic systems: 2 — Botania replacement, not a fit host
D4 magic systems: 2 — Botania replacement, not a fit host
fit host for item-equipment (accessory slots); no milestone A candidate requires it, so it needs an explicit include
D4 quest layer: Odyssey Quests is the settled single quest system (§7 row 25); JustQuests is an alternative, not a co-install
alshanex_familiars refuses to load without familiarslib 1.0.0+ (declared in the jar manifest); the Modrinth version metadata for the pinned build omits the link, so the closure cannot discover it
irons_spellbooks refuses to load without irons_lib [1.21.1-2,1.21.1-3) (declared in the jar manifest); the pinned build's Modrinth metadata omits it
irons_spellbooks refuses to load without playeranimator 2.0.1+1.21.1 (declared in the jar manifest); the pinned build's Modrinth metadata omits it
race-change traits need an origin layer; Neo Origins is a self-contained 1.21.1 NeoForge Origins port with 77 origins and 2 layers, and the server boot test is clean
Performance: Sodium port for NeoForge (client rendering).
